_doc: One deriver per domain fact. surfaces = files allowed to RENDER it; bannedPatterns = regexes that indicate a screen re-deriving the fact from raw fields (checked against app/ and src/components/). Grows in Phase 2/4.

day_planned_distance.note: banked + still-scheduled, resolved per WORKOUT — the Dash-16mi/planner-13mi bug class

week_mileage_gap.note: the SIGNED gap: >0 behind (orange), <0 over-allocated (green); one definition, both directions

quality_week_credit.note: HR-detected hard miles banked against the quality contract; never re-summed from raw activities
